name: ccshine
description: A clearer, better-looking Claude Code terminal: live task and agent progress with time left, one-line tool calls, a spinner that says what is running, usage and prompt-cache state, attention chimes and a matching status line. Needs Claude Code 2.1.288+.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Colour palette for everything ccshine draws

powerline.title: Powerline glyphs
powerline.description: Arrow and rounded-cap separators in headers (needs a Nerd Font)

tasks.title: Tasks band
tasks.description: Plan tasks, time left and agents above the prompt

tools.title: Tool rows
tools.description: Compact one-line tool calls with icons, edit counts and timings

spinner.title: Spinner activity
spinner.description: Spinner says what is running instead of a random word

usage.title: Usage line
usage.description: Cold-cache warnings and the token split by agent above the prompt

alerts.title: Attention alerts
alerts.description: Sound and toast when a long turn finishes or Claude needs you

alertAfterSeconds.title: Alert after (seconds)
alertAfterSeconds.description: Only alert for turns at least this long

transcript.title: Transcript style
transcript.description: Restyled prompts, replies and command output

chrome.title: Prompt chrome
chrome.description: Themed mode labels, notices and background hint; hides the turn duration line
